Embark on a journey through 16 engaging hands, aiming to accumulate the highest score possible. The team that chooses the trump suit must skillfully gather over half of the available points in a hand. Failing to do so means the opposition claims all the points. Strategy is key as points are earned through capturing tricks with high-value cards and securing bonus points during play.
